title: Cloud‑9: The First Known Failed Galaxy

scenes.text: Astronomers named a new failed galaxy—Cloud‑9.

scenes.label: LACK OF STARS
scenes.text: Cloud‑9 contains dark matter but almost no stars, making it a ‘failed’ galaxy.

scenes.label: UNUSUAL SPECTRA
scenes.text: Its spectral lines show high gas temperatures but no star‑forming regions.

scenes.label: MEASURED SIZE 30 KPC
scenes.text: The galaxy spans roughly 30 kpc, comparable to the Milky Way, yet it lacks visible light.
Follow for daily science that blows your mind.

description: Cloud‑9 challenges our definition of galaxies—massive yet starless. Follow for daily science!
